_comment: SQL 读写/语句类型跨语言契约（前后端唯一事实来源）。
服务端由 internal/db/dbm/classify_contract_test.go 读取（驱动生产方言装配的解析器 + sqlparser.Classify）；
前端由 views/ops/db/core/__tests__/classifyContract.test.ts 读取（isQueryStatement + 方言能力）。
stmtType = 后端 sqlparser.Classify 的权威分类（决定执行路由与触发策略）；isQuery = 前端 isQueryStatement 的读/写判定（决定结果 tab 布局与本地执行备注确认）。

多数情况 isQuery == (stmtType==select)。other 桶是有意差异：show/desc 后端归 other（读通道）、前端归只读；call/do/set/vacuum 后端仍归 other（读通道），前端按 fail-closed 归写入——两侧各自断言，本文件显式记录该分歧而非掩盖它。EXPLAIN ANALYZE <写> 已由后端解析器判为内层写类型（ExplainStmt.Inner），与前端一致。
可预期结果按真实数据库语义书写，而非任一实现的当前输出；任一侧改动分类规则都必须同步本文件，否则另一侧变红。

cases.name: select-基础
cases.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id > 1

cases.name: cte-纯读
cases.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM t) SELECT * FROM c

cases.name: update
cases.sql: UPDATE t SET a = 1 WHERE id = 2

cases.name: merge-oracle
cases.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.a = s.a

cases.name: merge-mssql
cases.sql: MERGE INTO t AS tgt USING s ON tgt.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.a = s.a;

cases.name: cte-主语句delete
cases.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM t) DELETE FROM u WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM c)

cases.name: 数据修改型cte
cases.sql: WITH c AS (DELETE FROM t RETURNING id) SELECT * FROM c

cases.name: select-into-建表
cases.sql: SELECT id INTO bak_users FROM users WHERE id > 1

cases.name: select-into-outfile
cases.sql: SELECT a FROM t INTO OUTFILE '/tmp/x.txt'

cases.name: explain-analyze-delete-两侧一致为写
cases.sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1

cases.name: select-字符串含DELETE
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE note = 'please DELETE the row'

cases.name: select-字符串含INSERT-INTO
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE sql_text = 'INSERT INTO x VALUES (1)'

cases.name: select-块注释含UPDATE
cases.sql: /* UPDATE t SET x = 1 */ SELECT * FROM dual

cases.name: select-CASE内串含insert
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN act = 'insert' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM t

cases.name: insert-值含DELETE文本
cases.sql: INSERT INTO logs VALUES ('DELETE FROM users')

cases.name: update-值含DROP文本
cases.sql: UPDATE t SET name = 'DROP TABLE x' WHERE id = 1

cases.name: update-JSON值含op-delete
cases.sql: UPDATE t SET payload = '{"op":"delete"}' WHERE id = 1

cases.name: cte-体内串含INSERT-INTO且主语句delete
cases.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT 'INSERT INTO x' AS s) DELETE FROM u WHERE id = 1

cases.name: cte-纯读-体内串含delete
cases.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM t) SELECT * FROM c WHERE x = 'delete from z'

cases.name: merge-ON条件串含delete
cases.sql: MERGE INTO t USING s ON (t.name = 'delete') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.a = s.a

cases.name: explain-analyze-update-内层写
cases.sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE UPDATE t SET x = 'delete'

cases.name: explain-analyze-select-后端读前端写
cases.sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM t WHERE x = 'y'

cases.name: select-oracle-q串含delete
cases.sql: SELECT q'[delete from t]' AS s FROM dual

cases.name: select-oracle-N串含关键词
cases.sql: SELECT N'insert into t' AS s FROM dual
